opening.speaker: Julian
opening.text: Lena, run! The Samsoian bandits are right on our heels. Don't worry about me—make for the valley!

opening.speaker: Lena
opening.text: Julian, you risked your life and turned your back on the bandit crew just to save me... I could never abandon you in this forsaken place!

opening.speaker: Caeda
opening.text: Marth! Do you hear those cries echoing down from the mountain pass? Someone is being hunted down by bandits!

opening.speaker: Marth
opening.text: That is the Devil Mountain, lair of the infamous Samsoian clan. Knights of Altea, double time! Rescue the innocents and clear the mountain of bandit filth!

recruit_navarre.speaker: Caeda
recruit_navarre.text: Swordsman Navarre! Please stay your blade. If your sword craves blood, strike me down first...

recruit_navarre.speaker: Navarre
recruit_navarre.text: An unarmed maiden... putting herself in harm's way before my sword?

recruit_navarre.speaker: Caeda
recruit_navarre.text: I can see the honor in your eyes. You are no heartless butcher for ruthless cutthroats. Please, lower your weapon!

recruit_navarre.speaker: Navarre
recruit_navarre.text: My blade does not cut women. Tell me who your enemies are. From this day forward, I shall fight for you.

village_devil_axe.speaker: Mountain Elder
village_devil_axe.text: Ah, brave Altean warriors! You dare venture into this accursed den? Hyman's Samsoian bandits have terrorized this mountain for years.

village_devil_axe.speaker: Mountain Elder
village_devil_axe.text: Deep in the caves I found this Devil Axe. Its striking power is devastating, but it carries a sinister curse that turns on its wielder if fortune fails. Take it, but swing it with caution!

boss_hyman.startCombat: You insolent Altean dogs dare invade Hyman's stronghold? My axe will feed your corpses to the mountain vultures!
boss_hyman.death: Curses... The great Samsoian bandits... crushed by mere youngsters...

ending.speaker: Julian
ending.text: Prince Marth! I am Julian. I lost my way and fell in with those brigands, but thanks to your rescue, I wish to dedicate my life to your righteous cause!

ending.speaker: Lena
ending.text: Your Highness, your compassion has saved us both. I am Lena, a cleric of Macedon. Please allow my healing staves to protect your brave soldiers.

ending.speaker: Marth
ending.text: We are honored to have you with us. Devil Mountain is finally liberated! Ahead of us stretch the great plains of Aurelis.

ending.speaker: Jagen
ending.text: Sire, Duke Hardin and the Wolfguard of Aurelis are bravely holding out against Dolhr forces ahead. Let us hasten onward to meet them!
